programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Un top porté par une variété de tons, de nationalités et d'économies qui fait plaisir à voir.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Il est temps de faire honneur et justice à ce grand film incompris qu'est Dirty Dancing.

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.4
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Crypto
programme.desc: Un jeune banquier de Wall Street, rétrogradé dans sa ville natale, découvre un réseau de corruption.

programme.title: Un Hologramme pour le Roi
programme.desc: Un homme d'affaires accepte un job en Arabie saoudite pour vendre une technologie à un puissant monarque.

programme.title: Romance en ligne
programme.desc: Une femme trouve l'amour sur un site de rencontre en ligne, mais son ex-petit ami a l'intention de la reconquérir.

programme.title: Misfits club
programme.desc: Valeria vient juste de déménager à Madrid après la séparation de ses parents. Nouvelles amitiés, une ville aux multiples opportunités, premier amour… Des expériences fortes qui changera à jamais la vie de Valeria et de son groupe d'amis.

programme.title: Célibataire cherche l'amour
programme.desc: Lucy Neal, une violoniste, se remet en question après que son ex petit ami ait décidé de rompre, la jugeant trop frigide. Afin de lui prouver le contraire, elle se lance dans la création d'une liste de choses “sexy” à réaliser.

programme.title: Y-a-t-il un youtuber dans l'avion ?
programme.desc: En route pour la plus grande convention de médias sociaux au monde en Australie, Logan Paul est mort de peur c'est la première fois qu'il prend l'avion. Tous ses pires cauchemars deviennent réalité lorsque les passagers refusent de passer leurs téléphones en mode avion...

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l'université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d'un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: Puzzle
programme.desc: Agnès, une mère de famille rangée vivant en banlieue, se découvre une passion pour les puzzles. Ce nouvel univers fait prendre à sa vie un tournant qu'elle n'aurait jamais imaginé.

programme.title: La Plus Belle Étoile de Noël
programme.desc: Une médecin rentre chez elle pour Noël et découvre que son père a décidé de prendre sa retraite. Après avoir retrouvé son amour de lycée, elle se demande si elle doit rester et reprendre le cabinet de son père.

programme.title: La Compétition de Noël
programme.desc: Après que son père a été blessé dans un accident de bois, Katie Jolly doit participer à un concours de bûcherons pour sauver l'entreprise familiale. Mais lorsque l'ambulancier qui a sauvé la vie de son père participe également au concours, une histoire d'amour se noue juste à temps pour Noël.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Wedding Bell Blues
programme.desc: Trois femmes partagent un appartement. Un abandon soudain les conduit à Las Vegas.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Au début des années 2000, une adolescente catholique et bien rangée découvre la tentation sur un chat aol.

programme.title: Romance de rêve
programme.desc: Un plombier solitaire se fait passer pour un réalisateur pour rencontrer des femmes.

programme.title: Let it Snow
programme.desc: Par un grand jour de neige, James rencontre Sarah. Des années plus tard, les deux se retrouvent à New York.

programme.title: À Propos D'hier Soir
programme.desc: Remake du film "A propos d'hier soir", basé sur la pièce de David Mamet. Cette réécriture moderne de la comédie romantique classique suit les nouveaux amours de deux couples, du bar à la chambre à coucher, jusqu'à ce qu'ils affrontent le monde réel.

programme.title: 30 Minutes Maximum
programme.desc: Livreur de pizzas, Nick est kidnappé par deux apprentis criminels. Ceux-ci fixent sur sa poitrine une bombe qu'ils menacent de faire exploser s'il refuse de cambrioler une banque. Nick n'a que quelques heures pour accomplir sa mission impossible. Affolé, il demande l'aide de son ex-meilleur ami, Chet. L'heure tourne, et voilà les deux complices obligés d'échapper à la police, à un tueur à gages, à un lance-flammes… Mais le plus difficile pour eux dans tout ça, c'est encore d'arriver à s'entendre !

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Carl Casper, Chef cuisinier, préfère démissionner soudainement de son poste plutôt que d'accepter de compromettre son intégrité créative par les décisions du propriétaire de l'établissement. Il doit alors décider de son avenir. Se retrouvant ainsi à Miami, il s'associe à son ex-femme, son ami et son fils pour lancer un food truck. En prenant la route, le Chef Carl retourne à ses racines et retrouve la passion pour la cuisine et un zeste de vie et d'amour.

programme.title: Big Party
programme.desc: A leur soirée de fin d'année, des étudiants se retrouvent pour une grande fête, parler de leur avenir et tenter de s'éloigner le plus possible de la vie sage et routinière qu'ils avaient été obligés de suivre jusqu'à présent.

programme.title: Le Chevalier black
programme.desc: Jamal Walker est un employé de Medieval World, un parc à thème vétuste. Il se retrouve soudain projeté dans le passé, au cœur de l'Angleterre du XIVe siècle.

programme.title: (S)ex List
programme.desc: Anna Faris et Chris Evans se partagent la vedette dans cette comédie sur une femme célibataire qui essaie de trouver le véritable amour en se lançant dans une recherche hilarante pour trouver le meilleur ex-petit ami de sa vie.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Super Héros Movie
programme.desc: Un adolescent orphelin est mordu par une libellule radioactive, ce qui lui confère des pouvoirs surhumains dans cette parodie de films tels que "Spider-Man", "X-Men" et "Fantastic Four".

programme.title: Le dernier tueur
programme.desc: Les parents de Ramon sont assassinés par les hommes du propriétaire terrien John Barrett.

programme.title: Billy le Kid
programme.desc: Tom Carter envoie son fils Billy chercher l'aide du shérif lorsque la ferme est attaquée par les hommes de main du voisin Jon Pryce.

programme.title: La Piste de Santa Fé
programme.desc: L'histoire de Jeb Stuart, de sa romance et de ses combats avec John Brown dans les jours qui ont précédé le déclenchement de la guerre civile américaine.

programme.title: La vallée de la peur
programme.desc: Dans les années 1880, un garçon hanté par des cauchemars sur la nuit où toute sa famille a été assassinée est élevé par une famille voisine.

programme.title: Arizona Bill
programme.desc: Un cavalier solitaire rencontre un soldat mourant, qui lui remet un papier autorisant le versement de 150 000 dollars à l'armée américaine.

programme.title: Buckaroo ne pardonne pas
programme.desc: Al arrive dans la ville dirigée par Lash qui a pris possession d'une mine d'or et cherche maintenant à récupérer l'autre, qui appartient au vieux Johnny. Al est le seul à soutenir Johnny mais le vieil homme est quand même pris en embuscade et tué.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Je Suis Vivant !
programme.desc: A Prague, le corps de Gregory Moore, un journaliste américain, est retrouvé dans un parc. Il est déclaré mort à la morgue, mais il est victime d'une machination. En réalité il a été plongé dans un état de catalepsie et apparaît comme décédé aux yeux de la science. Or, son esprit fonctionne encore.

programme.title: STILL BORN : AU-DELA DE DEUX AMES
programme.desc: une nouvelle mère, donne naissance à des jumeaux, mais un seul d'entre eux est survie. Tout en s'occupant de son seul enfant Adam, elle soupçonne que quelque chose, une entité surnaturelle, l'a choisi et ne reculera devant rien pour le lui enlever.

programme.title: Terror Hospital
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants décide de se faire peur le soir d'Halloween en allant visiter un hôpital psychiatrique désaffecté. Hélàs, l'esprit d'un patient, autrefois brûlé vif alors qu'il tentait de s'enfuir, hante les lieux. Le fantôme psychopathe veut par tous les moyens quitter les lieux pour de bon...

programme.title: The Witch In The Window
programme.desc: Lorsque Simon, père divorcé, amène son fils de douze ans, Finn, dans une région rurale du Vermont pour aider à remettre en état une ancienne ferme, ils rencontrent l'esprit malin de Lydia, l'ancienne propriétaire, décédée bien que n'ayant jamais quitté les lieux.

programme.title: Big Foot
programme.desc: En 1970, deux hommes aux destins opposés : Harley Anderson et Simon Quint doivent s'unir pour chasser une créature légendaire vivant dans les montagnes : le `Big foot'.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: À la suite d'un événement catastrophique qui a détruit la civilisation, un jeune homme doit affronter un groupe de cannibales qui ont assassiné son père et volé le médicament qui maintient sa petite amie en vie.

programme.title: Ape vs Monster
programme.desc: Une capsule spatiale renfermant un chimpanzé revient sur Terre. Elle contient également une substance inconnue qui permet au singe, ainsi qu'à un lézard, d'atteindre des tailles gigantesques, entraînant une lutte entre eux sans merci pour la domination du monde.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Après qu'une pandémie virale a frappé le monde, John Wood a laissé derrière lui les vestiges d'une civilisation brisée pour retourner à ses racines dans les bois.

programme.title: Ultimate Chabite
programme.desc: Kevin, Antho, Erwan et Rodrigo lancent un chabite, qui ne va jamais s'arrêter. Au départ c'est un simple jeu viral et absurde, mais très vite les complications arrivent. Les accidents se multiplient et les autorités commencent à s'y intéresser, tandis qu'Antho, le plus radical des 4 amis...

programme.desc: Deux ouvriers qui travaillent depuis vingt ans dans la même boîte tentent de repasser le bac.

programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme.

programme.desc: Deux jeunes frères sont accusés de meurtres brutaux dans les années 90, au Brésil.

programme.desc: Un gardien de sécurité du centre commercial et ancien agent fédéral, croise le chemin d'un tueur de barons de la drogue après avoir sauvé une femme du danger.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis
programme.desc: Durant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, l'équipage d'un navire américain lutte pour survivre après son naufrage en pleine mer.

programme.title: Enemy Lines
programme.desc: Sous l'occupation en Pologne pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, une équipe de commandos alliés est envoyée dans une mission mortelle derrière les lignes ennemies pour extraire un spécialiste des fusées des mains des nazis.

programme.title: Le Masque du Démon
programme.desc: Au 17ème siècle, la sorcière Asa et son amant Igor, accusés de vampirisme, sont mis au supplice mais promettent une vengeance éternelle à leurs tortionnaires. Deux siècles plus tard, la malédiction se réalise : les vampires reviennent à la vie et recommencent à semer la terreur et la mort...

programme.title: The Lovers
programme.desc: Au cours d'un dîner romantique, un homme voit sa chair tomber brutalement. Et alors ? La vie continue.

programme.title: La Fille qui en Savait Trop
programme.desc: Jeune Américaine en vacances à Rome, Nora Davis assiste impuissante à un meurtre. Personne ne croyant son témoignage, elle se met à accumuler les indices afin de prouver sa bonne foi. Petit à petit, ce jeu de piste la met sur la voie de la prochaine victime : elle-même…

programme.title: What's Behind that Door?
programme.desc: Un couple vit depuis toujours dans une chambre sans portes ni fenêtres. Un jour, sa vie bascule lorsqu'il découvre derrière le papier peint une mystérieuse porte.

programme.title: L'Au-delà
programme.desc: Une jeune femme hérite d'un hôtel à la Nouvelle Orléans. Alors qu'elle entreprend des travaux de rénovation, des phénomènes étranges font de sa vie un véritable enfer.

programme.title: Invisibles
programme.desc: Louise est en rupture. Placardisée au travail, elle se sépare en plus de son compagnon, employé dans la même société. Au moment où elle apprend que son contrat n'est pas reconduit, elle est témoin d'agressions étranges.

programme.title: The Lamp
programme.desc: Un esprit maléfique contenu dans une vieille lampe à l'huile se réveille une nuit où des jeunes gens s'infiltrent dans le musée où elle est exposée.

programme.title: Piégés dans la savane
programme.desc: Après un crash d'avion dans le désert du Kalahari un jeune couple doit survivre.

programme.title: President Down
programme.desc: Un message secret annonce que le pacemaker de la Présidente a été compromis.

programme.title: Rottweiler
programme.desc: Laissé pour mort, un chien particulièrement féroce est réanimé et transformé par les laboratoires de l'armée en véritable cyborg.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Shirin s'installe avec son beau-fils Lucas, hanté par une présence maléfique dans la maison voisine.

programme.title: La chute des frères Krays
programme.desc: L'empire des frères Kray est menacé par leur folie, un policier obsédé veut les arrêter.

programme.title: Undercover Punch And Gun
programme.desc: Un policier d'élite travaille sous couverture pour infiltrer un réseau de drogue.

programme.title: Fast Color
programme.desc: Dès lors qu'elle découvre ses super-pouvoirs, Ruth est obligée de fuir loin des siens...

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Lorsque sa fille disparaît au lendemain d'un deal entre mafieux, la vie de Neelyn bascule.

programme.title: Hypertension 2
programme.desc: Un parrain de la mafia chinoise a remplacé le coeur de Chev Chelios par une prothèse qu'il doit régulièrement stimuler en s'envoyant des décharges électriques.

programme.title: The Hard Corps
programme.desc: Quand Wayne Barclay a témoigné contre le poids lourd de l'industrie musicale Terrell Singletery, il s'est fait un ennemi à vie. Terrel vient d'être libéré de prison et le temps qu'il a passé derrière les barreaux n'a fait qu'alimenter sa soif de vengeance, ce qui ne sera pas facile pour cet ancien détenu aigri. Lorsque Philip Sauvage forme une unité spéciale de baroudeurs et d'anciens soldats pour protéger Barclay, le voyou déterminé est forcé de se battre contre une équipe de combattants suffisamment expérimentés pour mener une petite guerre.

programme.title: Profession Tueur 2
programme.desc: Notre tueur professionnel est de retour et, cette fois, il va devoir affronter les meilleurs assassins du monde pour protéger le fils ingrat d'un parrain de la mafia, sauver la vie de son seul et unique ami et espérer renouer avec son père un peu détraqué.

programme.title: Souviens Toi L'ete Dernier
programme.desc: La nuit de la fête nationale, Julie, Helen, Ray et Barry ont par accident renversé un inconnu. Devant la crainte de leur avenir compromis par ce drame, ils décident de faire disparaître le corps et font le serment de ne rien dire à personne, jamais. L'été suivant, chacun des quatre amis se trouve confronté à des évenements terrifiants. Ils doivent se rendre à l'évidence : quelqu'un sait ce qu'ils ont fait et semble bien decidé à le leur faire payer.

programme.title: La Loi du Campus
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves, Kiefer Sutherland et Billy Zane interprètent des lycéens qui forment une milice pour combattre le crime dans leur quartier. Mais à mesure que leur pouvoir augmente, ils deviennent de plus en plus violents et dangereux.

programme.title: Le Diable a Ma Porte
programme.desc: Une épouse et mère de deux enfants mène une vie idéale qui connaît un virage soudain lorsque sa famille est menacée par un inconnu, qui se fait inviter dans sa maison en prétendant avoir un problème avec sa voiture ...

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. programme.title: The Pull of the Wild
programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, snakes have fostered our fascination, playing a significant role in our most ancient stories. Follow environmental photojournalist Aaron Gekoski as he investigates our relationship with one of the planet's most popular exotic pets: ball pythons. Traversing four continents, he witnesses sacred rituals, visits voodoo markets and joins expeditions into remote West Africa to discover how ball pythons make their way into the homes of pet owners, worldwide.

programme.title: Stork Army: Women Fighting for the Hargila
programme.desc: In South East Asia the Greater Adjutant Stork, known locally as the Hargila, is a sight to behold. But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: The Power of Plants The Great Escape
programme.desc: You think plants are boring or passive? Far from it! They use complex reactions to respond to light, sound and touch. And like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Plants have evolved tricks to beat the ele-ments, animal enemies or even other plants: From thorns and spines to poisons and even live-in bodyguards. This two-part series shows the survival strategies of our green “roommates” we share the planet with.

Traversing four continents, he witnesses sacred rituals, visits voodoo markets and joins expeditions into remote West Africa to discover how ball pythons make their way into the homes of pet owners, worldwide.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E02
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E03
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E04
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. Whoever wants to go from one place to another has to travel on roads that hardly deserve this name. They are dusty paths that don't appear on any map. They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E05
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier", the last outpost. Michelle Masden, for example, has come to terms with the harsh conditions here. She is the only seaplane pilot in the region. She earns her living with her 65-year-old Beaver: as an air taxi, transport plane and now and then as a rescuer in last necessity. Michelle flies anything and everything: spare parts and food, doctors, hikers and hunters. For the fishermen of southern Alaska she searches for large shoals of fish and guides the captains to the next good catch. Ray Rusaw was a car mechanic by profession, but in his old age he was gripped by gold fever. With a self-built special raft and a highly creative selection of equipment from the DIY store, he sets off in search of the precious metal that his predecessors overlooked two centuries ago. For four years he has been happily obsessively combing through sandbanks and river courses. For Ray, the search for gold has little to do with luck and much to do with meticulous research. He is certain that he has found the perfect spot.

programme.title: Wild Holland
programme.desc: The film celebrates the diverse natural heritage of the Dutch delta region while sketching the cultural context that has played such a vital part in shaping it. Using cutting edge cinematic techniques ranging from eagle's eye aerial views to unprecedented underwater scenes, 'Wild Holland - The Living Delta' presents a portrait of this unique wetland area of Europe as never seen before, capturing it in an important moment of change - a time when new life is flooding back into the delta.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Sambok means the three hottest days of summer in Korea, with the two of them falling in July. There is a tradition to eat nourishing food to beat the heat on these sambok days. One of the most popular dishes of this kind is samgyetang, or a bowl of whole chicken in a broth simmered with milk vetch roots, jujubes and garlic. Serve it with kkakdugi, or cubed radish kimchi, for a refreshing bite.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chicken chunks braised in sweet and savory soy sauce are one of the most popular delivery food items in Korea. The fresh vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots and onions make the dish much more enjoyable. Pair it with rice balls made of flying fish roe and chopped Korean pickled radish. You can enjoy the rice balls plain or dip them in the braised chicken broth for an extra kick.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: High in protein, potassium and phosphorus, brown croaker fish is known to help boost energy and beat fatigue in the summer. The versatile ingredient can be eaten raw, cooked in soup or braised. Another great way to enjoy it is to top it over rice in a stone pot. Try this healthy fish recipe with pickled onions and radishes to whet your appetite on a hot summer day.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make kimchi bokkeumbap, or rice stir-fried with chopped kimchi and vegetables. Made of the beloved Korean staple, this fried rice is easy and quick to make. The chef uses leftovers in the fridge to whip up this all-time favorite recipe, including day-old rice, sour kimchi, and bacon strips. Treat your family to this comforting and savory dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A hearty and soup made of octopus and vegetables is an excellent source of taurine, protein and calcium. Serve it with a spicy and crunchy cucumber and bellflower root salad on the side for a nourishing meal.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: One of the most popular late night delivery food items in Korea is tteokbokki, or spicy stir-fried rice cakes. Adding fresh seafood can give this iconic dish an extra rich flavor. Pair it with laver roll and squid fritters that are crispy outside and soft inside. The spicy tteokbokki sauce makes a delicious dipping sauce for fritters.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jul. 27 this year marks the 70th Anniversary of the Korean War Armistice Agreement. The ceasefire was meant to be a temporary measure until a peace treaty is reached, but it never came, and the Korean Peninsula is still in armistice. In this episode, we will make Pyeongyang naengmyeon, a cold noodles dish popular in both sides of the border, to remember the painful chapters of Korean history.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA

Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures that ends with Apple finding a new home with Strawberry and her friends.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.

programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: Getting Tthe Message
programme.desc: they need to brave space rides, dunking booths, an angry Friends' fun day at Heartlake Amusement Park turns into a innocent text to Mia was sent to Matthew by mistake -- a As the Friends enjoy Heartlake Amusement Park, Emma types a text to Mia, but sends it to Matthew by mistake a text that could be mega-embarrassing for Emma! As her BFF's, the Friends race to find Matthew's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, they must brave space rides, dunking booths and worse: the boys locker room! What's more frightening than a roller coaster? More BFF's, the Friends must scramble to retrieve Matthew's brute and worse - the boys locker room!phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, twisted than a funhouse mirror? A text gone wrong! The undying love for Matthew! Mega-embarrassing! As Emma's frantic race against time when Emma discovers that her text that accidentally sounds like a pledge of Emma's

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Berry Naughty
programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Laundry Day
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Princess or Dragon?
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn't you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Well-beeing
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: How to Train Your Plant
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Recipe For Disaster
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: The Mystery Guest
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemons
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Grim Testament About One Snotty Boy
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?!

programme.title: Panic Unbearable Legend About Insects
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can't be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Happy New Year… Again!

programme.title: ISTANBUL: WHERE EMPIRES MEET THE FUTURE
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the vibrant crossroads of Istanbul, uncovering how ancient empires and modern innovation collide to shape the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins with the new direct flight path from Colorado to Istanbul, a gateway to what Turkish Airlines Chairman Ahmet Bolat calls the 'beginning of civilization and culture.' From their base at the Shangri-La Bosphorus—a historic 1920s tobacco warehouse turned luxury landmark—the hosts witness the literal meeting point of Europe and Asia on the Bosphorus Strait. Guided by local experts, the episode explores the architectural force of the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque, reflecting a city reinvented from the Byzantine and Ottoman eras into a modern republic. The exploration moves beneath the streets to the 2,000-year-old Basilica Cistern before emerging into the sensory experience of the Grand Bazaar, the historic center of global trade. The narrative then shifts to modern medical tourism at EsteNove to investigate Istanbul's role as a global healthcare hub. The journey concludes by blending cultural rituals—from the art of Turkish coffee fortune telling to the 40-layer craftsmanship of baklava—proving that in Istanbul, the past is an active, breathing part of the city's future.

programme.title: SOUTH AFRICA UNCORKED: SOUL, SEA & SAFARI
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature's masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM GURUDWARA SRI SIS GANJ SAHIB

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents the Music & Lyrics Special in celebration of its 4th anniversary! And the second guest of the special trilogy is singer-songwriter JEONGMILLA. JEONGMILLA is known for her delicate poetic depictions of everyday life combined with heartwarming folk sounds. Interestingly enough she started off her career through fine arts after graduating from the prestigious Korea National University of Arts. And she says music and art are both important to her in different ways. In October last year JEONGMILLA released her third full-length album CheongPa Sonata. Inspired by the neighborhood she lives in Cheongpa-dong she delicately painted the quotidian scenes of the area with her personal stories. Since its release the album has been highly recommended by critics on various music charts and with this album she won three trophies at the 2021 Korean Music Awards -- Best Song - Folk Best Album - Folk and Best Album of the Year. In this episode JEONGMILLA performs Stars Departing from Seoul Station Old Town Journal During Troubled Times and Wandering. Tune in to I'm LIVE and explore her poetic artistic world!

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam

Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Sambok means the three hottest days of summer in Korea, with the two of them falling in July. There is a tradition to eat nourishing food to beat the heat on these sambok days. One of the most popular dishes of this kind is samgyetang, or a bowl of whole chicken in a broth simmered with milk vetch roots, jujubes and garlic. Serve it with kkakdugi, or cubed radish kimchi, for a refreshing bite.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chicken chunks braised in sweet and savory soy sauce are one of the most popular delivery food items in Korea. The fresh vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots and onions make the dish much more enjoyable. Pair it with rice balls made of flying fish roe and chopped Korean pickled radish. You can enjoy the rice balls plain or dip them in the braised chicken broth for an extra kick.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: High in protein, potassium and phosphorus, brown croaker fish is known to help boost energy and beat fatigue in the summer. The versatile ingredient can be eaten raw, cooked in soup or braised. Another great way to enjoy it is to top it over rice in a stone pot. Try this healthy fish recipe with pickled onions and radishes to whet your appetite on a hot summer day.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make kimchi bokkeumbap, or rice stir-fried with chopped kimchi and vegetables. Made of the beloved Korean staple, this fried rice is easy and quick to make. The chef uses leftovers in the fridge to whip up this all-time favorite recipe, including day-old rice, sour kimchi, and bacon strips. Treat your family to this comforting and savory dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A hearty and soup made of octopus and vegetables is an excellent source of taurine, protein and calcium. Serve it with a spicy and crunchy cucumber and bellflower root salad on the side for a nourishing meal.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: One of the most popular late night delivery food items in Korea is tteokbokki, or spicy stir-fried rice cakes. Adding fresh seafood can give this iconic dish an extra rich flavor. Pair it with laver roll and squid fritters that are crispy outside and soft inside. The spicy tteokbokki sauce makes a delicious dipping sauce for fritters.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jul. 27 this year marks the 70th Anniversary of the Korean War Armistice Agreement. The ceasefire was meant to be a temporary measure until a peace treaty is reached, but it never came, and the Korean Peninsula is still in armistice. In this episode, we will make Pyeongyang naengmyeon, a cold noodles dish popular in both sides of the border, to remember the painful chapters of Korean history.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: 1Day 1Korea K-Food shared a wide variety of Korean food recipes this year. But how did our viewers like them? For this week's episode, one of the foreign viewers and a big fan of 1Day 1Korea joins us to try out his favorite recipe featured on the show, dakbokkeumtang. Chunks of juicy tender chicken are braised in spicy sauce to make the savory dish perfect for a year-end celebration.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: No Korean New Year's celebration is complete without tteokguk, or rice cake soup. In fact, Koreans consider themselves a year older when eating a bowl of tteokguk. The traditional dish also represents a wish for a prosperous New Year. For this New Year's special, the chef and her cooking class students join us to make this hearty soup to share with neighbors.
